_comment: Two leaves the terminology sweep surfaced. sectionLanding.desc.credentials had collapsed from a full sentence into the two characters 證書 -- which is wrong twice over: the description vanished, and 證書 means a certificate or diploma rather than a stored account secret, so the Credentials tile's subtitle read 'Diploma' under a heading that already said 認證資料. Restored as a real translation, using 認證資料 to agree with sectionLanding.group.credentials. help:defenseHeatMap shipped 可访问 -- Simplified glyphs inside a Traditional pack -- and this same sentence is already translated correctly in dashboard:defense.heatMapAria as 無障礙來源, so the help text is aligned to the pack's own existing wording rather than a new draft. AGENT DRAFT on the credentials description; the heat-map fix is reuse of reviewed text from a sibling key.

source.sectionLanding.desc.credentials: Rotate passwords on demand, request break-glass reveal, and open per-target schedules.

zh-TW.sectionLanding.desc.credentials: 隨需輪替密碼、要求緊急破窗顯示，以及開啟每個目標的排程。
